# Projection Function

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ProjectionFunction`](gmeow-ProjectionFunction.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProjectionFunction>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An FnO function that renders canonical frame-relative content to a notation system ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`fno:Function`](https://w3id.org/function/ontology#Function)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ProjectionFunction`](gmeow-ProjectionFunction.md) as a specialized kind of [`fno:Function`](https://w3id.org/function/ontology#Function). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to type the executable FnO function that performs a notation render — the solver-layer object a projection profile points at to actually turn canonical content into a surface form.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting the function's output as canonical data and avoid hand-encoding the render math in the ontology; the function is a solver-layer reference (P12), declared here, executed there.

### How to use

- Type the function as [`ProjectionFunction`](gmeow-ProjectionFunction.md) (an [fno:Function](https://w3id.org/function/ontology#Function)), reference it from a profile via [`gmeow:projectionFunction`](../properties/gmeow-projectionFunction.md), and declare its input through [`gmeow:projectableExpression`](../properties/gmeow-projectableExpression.md); the solver supplies the implementation.

### Examples

- ex:renderStaff a [`gmeow:ProjectionFunction`](gmeow-ProjectionFunction.md).
